[P2] Finish examples-package coverage for the public operations

The new examples-package fixture covers `check` and `classify`, but `llm.ask` still appears only in this manually deployed handler outside the standard integration workflow; `label` and `score` also lack examples-package coverage. Root AGENTS.md Tests rule 3 and CONTRIBUTING require this coverage for new public APIs. Return to the testing design and cover the remaining operations through the examples workflow with result and history assertions. Injected clients and transports can provide deterministic replies without a deployed model.
